title: DILG, PNP chiefs visit Banga school after deadly shooting

blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla and Philippine National Police chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. arrived at Banga National High School before noon Monday, three days after a deadly shooting inside the campus shocked the community. Remulla and Nartatez inspected the school to assess the situation and security measures being implemented following the Sept. 18 shooting.
